senses.nuances: 本义项是待语境确认的人名识别，不是已核实的普通马来语词义。马来西亚公共图书馆目录确有作者 K. Morgan 的记录，但该记录不能证明输入中的 morgan 就指这位作者。以下为人名的示例组合，并非经频率统计确认的固定搭配；中文“摩根”也须服从具体人物通行译名。[MBPJ 图书馆目录](https://webopac.mbpjlibrary.gov.my/webopac/Record/0000326048/Details?sid=293107756)

etymology.historical_story: Names travel through books and bibliographies without becoming ordinary vocabulary. A Malaysian public-library catalogue, for example, records K. Morgan as an author of a business textbook. That supplies evidence for Morgan as a name in Malaysian material, but not an etymology for this packet's unidentified token. Its particular origin and pronunciation remain unresolved. [MBPJ library catalogue](https://webopac.mbpjlibrary.gov.my/webopac/Record/0000326048/Details?sid=293107756)
